title: Halogenation of nucleic acid structures: from chemical biology to supramolecular chemistry
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00077G, Review Article

Catalina Nicolau, Julia Requena-Ramírez, Jorge González-García, Antonio Bauzá
In this review article, the impact of nucleobase halogenation in chemical biology and supramolecular chemistry has been discussed, highlighting the importance of halogen bonding interactions as a novel molecular recognition tool.
